name: @coasys/ad4m-integration-tests
description: Node.js package that allows the running/interfacing of AD4M Languages & Perspectives.

scripts.test-main: node scripts/cleanTestingData.js && pnpm run prepare-test && pnpm run test-all && node scripts/cleanTestingData.js
scripts.test:windows: pnpm run prepare-test:windows && pnpm run test-all:windows && node scripts/cleanTestingData.js
scripts.test-all:windows: node scripts/cleanup.js && pnpm run test-smoke && node scripts/cleanup.js && pnpm run test-auth && node scripts/cleanup.js && pnpm run test-integration && node scripts/cleanup.js && pnpm run test-sdna && node scripts/cleanup.js && pnpm run test-smart-literal && node scripts/cleanup.js && pnpm run test-model
scripts.test-all: node scripts/cleanup.js && pnpm run test-smoke && node scripts/cleanup.js && pnpm run test-auth && node scripts/cleanup.js && pnpm run test-integration && node scripts/cleanup.js && pnpm run test-sdna && node scripts/cleanup.js && pnpm run test-smart-literal && node scripts/cleanup.js && pnpm run test-model
scripts.test-auth: ts-mocha -p tsconfig.json --require tests/setup.ts --timeout 1200000 --exit tests/auth/app.test.ts tests/auth/authentication.test.ts tests/auth/email-verification.test.ts
scripts.test-multi-user: node scripts/cleanup.js && pnpm run test-multi-user-auth && node scripts/cleanup.js && pnpm run test-multi-user-connect && node scripts/cleanup.js && pnpm run test-multi-user-config && node scripts/cleanup.js && pnpm run test-multi-user-isolation && node scripts/cleanup.js && pnpm run test-multi-user-sdna && node scripts/cleanup.js && pnpm run test-multi-user-profiles && node scripts/cleanup.js && pnpm run test-multi-user-neighbourhood && node scripts/cleanup.js && pnpm run test-multi-user-multi-node && node scripts/cleanup.js && pnpm run test-multi-user-subscriptions && node scripts/cleanup.js && pnpm run test-multi-user-notifications
scripts.test-model: node scripts/cleanup.js && ts-mocha -p tsconfig.json --timeout 120000 --serial --exit --require tests/model/hooks.ts tests/model/model-core.test.ts tests/model/model-query.test.ts tests/model/model-subscriptions.test.ts tests/model/model-transactions.test.ts tests/model/model-inheritance.test.ts tests/model/model-prolog.test.ts tests/model/model-where-operators.test.ts tests/model/model-from-json-schema.test.ts tests/model/model-advanced.test.ts
scripts.prepare-test:macos: ./scripts/build-test-language.sh && ./scripts/prepareTestDirectory.sh && deno run --allow-all scripts/get-builtin-test-langs.js && pnpm run inject-language-language && pnpm run publish-test-languages && pnpm run inject-publishing-agent
scripts.prepare-test:linux: ./scripts/build-test-language.sh && ./scripts/prepareTestDirectory.sh && deno run --allow-all scripts/get-builtin-test-langs.js && pnpm run inject-language-language && pnpm run publish-test-languages && pnpm run inject-publishing-agent
scripts.prepare-test:windows: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File ./scripts/build-test-language.ps1 && powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File ./scripts/prepareTestDirectory.ps1 && deno run --allow-all scripts/get-builtin-test-langs.js && pnpm run inject-language-language && pnpm run publish-test-languages && pnpm run inject-publishing-agent
scripts.test-single-prepare: node scripts/cleanTestingData.js && pnpm run prepare-test && node scripts/cleanup.js
